result.title: KeyWise: Efficient Video-Only Piano Transcription with a Lightweight Per-Key Architecture
result.summary: Audio-based piano transcription is hampered by the sustain pedal and by noisy or missing soundtracks, problems that video-only transcription avoids, since a top-view video shows directly when each key is pressed and released. Most visual transcription networks, however, describe the whole keyboard with one global feature vector and must learn where each key is. In this paper, we propose KeyWise, a lightweight per-key architecture that exploits the known geometry of the keyboard instead of learning it. The rectified keyboard is divided into 88 equal tiles that serve as regions of interest (ROIs), and one small recurrent network, shared by all keys, follows each key over time. On PianoVAM, KeyWise reaches the onset accuracy of the state-of-the-art V2N (95.0% vs. 94.7% onset F1 at 50 ms and 97.8% vs. 97.0% at 100 ms) with 1.3 M instead of 28.2 M parameters, and it runs 4.7 times faster on the same GPU. At 100 ms, it is also significantly more accurate when the key releases (97.0% vs. 95.5% F1) or the velocities (89.4% vs. 84.5% F1) must be correct as well. On PianoYT, KeyWise pre-trained on PianoVAM reaches 69.4% onset F1 at 100 ms, comparable to the best published result, although it needs fine-tuning for new recording conditions.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 KeyWise：将校正后的键盘划分为 88 个按键 ROI，用一个共享的小型循环网络逐键跟踪按下、松开与力度，实现轻量的纯视频钢琴转写，在 PianoVAM 上以更少参数和更高速度取得与 V2N 相当的准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用已知几何先验替代学习式空间注意、并为每个实体维护独立循环状态的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的定向筛选与实体级状态更新提供参考，但任务域较远，具体可迁移性需核查。
